title: Predicting Duodenal Cancer Risk in Patients with Familial Adenomatous Polyposis Using Machine Learning Model.
authors: Akbulut, Sami; Kucukakcali, Zeynep; Colak, Cemil
journal: The Turkish journal of gastroenterology : the official journal of Turkish Society of Gastroenterology
one_liner_zh: 该研究用XGboost对家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者的十二指肠癌表达谱进行分类，纯基因表达生物标志物预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无结合建模、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: The aim of this study was to both classify data of familial adenomatous polyposis patients with and without duode- nal cancer and to identify important genes that may be related to duodenal cancer by XGboost model. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The current study was performed using expression profile data from a series of duodenal samples from familial adenomatous polyposis patients to explore variations in the familial adenomatous polyposis duodenal adenoma-carcinoma sequence. The expression profiles obtained from cancerous, adenomatous, and normal tissues of 12 familial adenomatous polyposis patients with duodenal cancer and the tissues of 12 familial adenomatous polyposis patients without duodenal cancer were compared. The ElasticNet approach was utilized for the feature selection. Using 5-fold cross-validation, one of the machine learning approaches, XGboost, was utilized to classify duodenal cancer. Accuracy, balanced accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and F1 score performance metrics were assessed for model performance. RESULTS: According to the variable importance obtained from the modeling, ADH1C, DEFA5, CPS1, SPP1, DMBT1, VCAN-AS1, APOB genes (cancer vs. adenoma); LOC399753, APOA4, MIR548X, and ADH1C genes (adenoma vs. adenoma); SNORD123, CEACAM6, SNORD78, ANXA10, SPINK1, and CPS1 (normal vs. adenoma) genes can be used as predictive biomarkers. CONCLUSIONS: The proposed model used in this study shows that the aforementioned genes can forecast the risk of duodenal cancer in patients with familial adenomatous polyposis. More comprehensive analyses should be performed in the future to assess the reliability of the genes determined.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：本研究旨在对伴有和不伴有十二指肠癌的家族性腺瘤性息肉病（familial adenomatous polyposis）患者数据进行分类，并通过XGboost模型识别可能与十二指肠癌相关的重要基因。材料与方法：本研究利用来自家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者一系列十二指肠样本的表达谱数据，探讨家族性腺瘤性息肉病十二指肠腺瘤-癌序列中的变异。比较了12例伴有十二指肠癌的家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者和12例不伴有十二指肠癌的家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者的癌组织、腺瘤组织和正常组织的表达谱。采用ElasticNet方法进行特征选择。使用5折交叉验证，利用机器学习方法之一XGboost对十二指肠癌进行分类。评估了准确率、平衡准确率、敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值、阴性预测值和F1分数等性能指标以评价模型表现。结果：根据建模获得的变量重要性，ADH1C、DEFA5、CPS1、SPP1、DMBT1、VCAN-AS1、APOB基因（癌 vs. 腺瘤）；LOC399753、APOA4、MIR548X和ADH1C基因（腺瘤 vs. 腺瘤）；SNORD123、CEACAM6、SNORD78、ANXA10、SPINK1和CPS1（正常 vs. 腺瘤）基因可作为预测性生物标志物。结论：本研究中使用的模型表明，上述基因可预测家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者发生十二指肠癌的风险。未来应进行更全面的分析，以评估所确定基因的可靠性。
